name: wp-project-security-audit
description: Verification-first security and vulnerability audit of a whole WordPress project: component inventory, dependency and known-vulnerability sweeps at the production version, vendor compromise, secrets, deploy and exposure, cross-component correlation, and dispatch of custom plugins and themes to their component audits. Produces an area-sectioned report with a GO / NO-GO / GO WITH FIXES verdict for production as deployed. Requires wp-plugin-code-audit and wp-theme-code-audit.
